summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing Phase 3-enabling topline results from the Phase 2 portion of the RADIANT trial of remlifanserin in Alzheimer's disease psychosis. The 60 mg dose produced a -12.6 versus -10.4 placebo change on SAPS-H+D at week 6 (effect size 0.26, p=0.0603), while CGI-S-ADP showed 1.3 versus 0.9 (effect size 0.37, nominal p=0.0077). Safety was favorable; the 30 mg arm will be removed and Phase 3 enrollment continues. This is a clinical data disclosure, not a special situation.
